title: The Price of Speed: Optimising Dark-Store Networks and Rider Assignment under Relaxed Delivery Promises in Indian Quick Commerce (code, data and manuscript)
description: Code, data and manuscript for a bibliometric review of operations research on last-mile and on-demand delivery (168 articles, 2015-2026) and an optimisation case study of Bengaluru's quick-commerce dark-store network. Code: MIT. Manuscript and figures: CC BY 4.0. OpenStreetMap-derived data: ODbL 1.0. WorldPop-derived data: CC BY 4.0. See LICENSES.md.
notes: OpenStreetMap-derived files are ODbL 1.0 (© OpenStreetMap contributors); see data/LICENSE.md.
